caption: The drawing depicts a segment of an ornate wrought iron fence or gate, rendered in grayscale on a light beige background. The fence is composed of vertical and horizontal bars forming a grid, with each intersection covered by a circular rosette ornament. The rightmost vertical bar is adorned with decorative finials at the top, including a pointed spear, a fleur-de-lis, and an acorn-shaped ornament. The upper section of the central portion features two symmetrical, upward-curving scrolls with spirals, and in the center above these is a rectangular frame containing a cross that extends beyond the frame vertically. Near the bottom left corner of the composition, there is a separate, circular rosette design with four short bars extending diagonally outward. Behind the detailed lines of the fence, faint architectural elements are visible in the background, rendered in a much lighter and sketchier style. The overall color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black.
title: Iron Gate and Fence
